Frozen base commit: `a748b01de5b7f29dfdd5eb19dadb40881ae4b8ca`. Checked: `2026-10-01T16:34:12.099170Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- Current/base SVG: [base.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/8a0ad24d519497e362904efe879ce5d82c472632/review-materials/3/base.svg) — SHA-256 `c08119921a3858373c36aad8567dd3c2d54c55630cdc076b6f6cd999f0de2ce5`.

- Exact base-to-final changes: [candidate.diff](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/8a0ad24d519497e362904efe879ce5d82c472632/review-materials/3/candidate.diff).

- Source asset: [https://static.rustore.ru/afb07f02-5399-4f45-a366-e49a7b3420ad](https://static.rustore.ru/afb07f02-5399-4f45-a366-e49a7b3420ad).

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-01T16:22:00Z: [https://www.rustore.ru/catalog/app/ru.alfabank.mobile.android](https://www.rustore.ru/catalog/app/ru.alfabank.mobile.android); asset [https://static.rustore.ru/afb07f02-5399-4f45-a366-e49a7b3420ad](https://static.rustore.ru/afb07f02-5399-4f45-a366-e49a7b3420ad). 368x368 PNG app icon from АО «Альфа-Банк»'s own RuStore developer account: white А + underscore on full-bleed red square, monogram only, no wordmark or slogan. Observed live 2026-10-01; the original downloaded bytes are retained in the maintenance session's private evidence storage and are not part of this repository. (independence group: official publisher listing \(АО «Альфа-Банк»\)).
- official checked 2026-10-01T16:22:00Z: [https://alfabank.ru/favicon.ico](https://alfabank.ru/favicon.ico); asset [https://alfabank.ru/favicon.ico](https://alfabank.ru/favicon.ico). Official favicon 32x32 transparent: red А + underscore \(same mark, small raster\). Main-site pages returned HTTP 403 bot protection \(TLS verified, packaged-CA retry used\); raw transfer logs stay local and are not published. (independence group: official site of АО «Альфа-Банк»).
- third-party checked 2026-10-01T16:22:00Z: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alfa-Bank.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alfa-Bank.svg). 2015 public-domain full logo \(#ee2a23\) confirms the А+underscore mark geometry and red color; rejected as replacement \(includes wordmark\). (independence group: Wikimedia Commons).
- zenplugins-issue checked 2026-10-01T16:22:00Z: [https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo%3Azenmoney%2FZenPlugins+%22%D0%90%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%84%D0%B0-%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%22+is%3Aissue](https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo%3Azenmoney%2FZenPlugins+%22%D0%90%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%84%D0%B0-%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%22+is%3Aissue). 11 results \(HTTP 200, open+closed\), all sync/plugin topics \(notably #1169 open, alfabank-by\); none about the icon/logo. (independence group: zenmoney/ZenPlugins search).
- zenplugins-pr checked 2026-10-01T16:22:00Z: [https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo%3Azenmoney%2FZenPlugins+%22%D0%90%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%84%D0%B0-%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%22+is%3Apr](https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo%3Azenmoney%2FZenPlugins+%22%D0%90%D0%BB%D1%8C%D1%84%D0%B0-%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%22+is%3Apr). 0 results \(HTTP 200\), including closed. (independence group: zenmoney/ZenPlugins search).
- Independent evidence: Primary evidence is the bank's own app-store listing and site favicon; Wikimedia \(independent\) corroborates mark geometry/color continuity..
- Identity: confirmed — The fetched asset is АО «Альфа-Банк»'s own app icon on its official RuStore listing: white А+underscore monogram on red — the bank's documented mark..
- Currency: confirmed — Live official app listing observed 2026-10-01; official favicon shows the same mark today; 2015 Wikimedia geometry corroborates continuity of the mark..
- Variant: confirmed — Standalone monogram treatment \(no wordmark/slogan\), square-cell native; the documented red-square composition differs from the accepted red-circle backing..

Rationale: Update backing composition to the bank's documented current red-square app mark while preserving the exact accepted glyph geometry..
Role: app mark: full-bleed red square with white А+underscore monogram, no lettering; variant: standalone monogram on full-bleed red square \(#EF3124\), matching АО «Альфа-Банк»'s current official app icon.
Visible difference: Accepted icon is the А+underscore mark on a red circle; candidate is the same mark on a full-bleed red square — the composition of the bank's current official app icon \(visible in the bound before/after pairs on both themes\)..
Details: Underscore bar and А counters render cleanly at 240px on both themes; square corners sharp; no artifacts after conversion.. Proportions: Glyph occupies slightly less of the square than in the official 368px icon \(accepted glyph geometry preserved verbatim\); composition, alignment and margins read correctly and match the documented red-square mark..

Source-to-final transformations:
- Backing replaced: accepted red circle \(r=27, #ee3424\) removed; full-bleed 54x54 rect added with #ef3124 sampled from the official 368px app icon PNG \(corner pixel 239,49,36\).
- White А+underscore glyph paths copied byte-identically from the accepted SVG; no scaling, repositioning or geometry edits.
- SVGO 4.1.0 \(config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e\): 721 -\> 682 bytes; working vs optimized rsvg reference renders pixel-identical \(identical SHA-256\); optimized selected.

### Light and dark before/after

![Before and after — light background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/8a0ad24d519497e362904efe879ce5d82c472632/review-materials/3/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

![Before and after — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/8a0ad24d519497e362904efe879ce5d82c472632/review-materials/3/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-01T16:32:45.931504779Z`. Source/final: the original 368x368 official PNG \(white А+underscore on full-bleed red #EF3124, downloaded from the bank's official RuStore listing and retained with its original hash\) matches the final SVG's treatment; the glyph is slightly smaller relative to the square than in the source PNG because the accepted vector geometry was preserved verbatim; colors match. Base/final and rendering: the bound before/after pairs on both themes show the base red circle replaced by the full-bleed red square with the same glyph; offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource renders are clean on #FFFFFF and #121212 — flat square, crisp glyph, no clipping or distortion; the change is visible and matches the official current composition.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No Android CLI installed; run-owned AVD creation unavailable offline; user AVDs not auto-selected. Residual risk: converter behavior verified only via offscreen Compose Desktop export with identical generated XML path..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Same limitation as android-compose..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — Linux host: no iOS simulator/runtime available..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — Linux host: no iOS toolchain available..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.
